name: 核心高頻英文
description: 日常閱讀、寫作與學術最常遇到的高價值英文詞彙

words.meaning: 不期而遇的美好；意外發現珍寶的運氣
words.example: Finding that cozy café in the alley was pure serendipity.
Cherry blossoms are cherished for their ephemeral beauty.

words.meaning: 有韌性的；能迅速恢復的
words.example: She remained resilient despite all the unexpected setbacks.
We need a pragmatic approach to solve this scheduling conflict.

words.meaning: 無所不在的；隨處可見的
words.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern daily life.

words.meaning: 一絲不苟的；極為細心的
words.example: He kept meticulous notes during every experiment.

words.meaning: 雄辯的；有說服力且流暢的
words.example: Her eloquent speech moved everyone in the auditorium.
A short walk can help alleviate eye strain and fatigue.

words.meaning: 模稜兩可的；含糊不清的
words.example: The instructions were ambiguous, leading to two different interpretations.
I appreciate your candid feedback on my draft.
Make sure your essay presents a clear and coherent argument.
Consistent, diligent practice beats last-minute cramming.

words.meaning: 同理心；感同身受的能力
words.example: Good product design starts with deep empathy for users.
Finishing the prototype by Friday seems feasible.

words.meaning: 不可避免的；必然發生的
words.example: Change is an inevitable part of growing up.

words.meaning: 清晰易懂的；頭腦清楚的
words.example: The professor gave a lucid explanation of quantum mechanics.
Backups help mitigate the risk of accidental data loss.
Translating poetry requires capturing every subtle nuance.
Floppy disks became obsolete decades ago.
It is a curious paradox that resting well helps you get more done.
That sounds like a plausible hypothesis worth testing.
Reading that book had a profound impact on my perspective.
Auditors scrutinized every transaction in the annual report.
We took a spontaneous weekend trip to the mountains.
There is a subtle difference in flavor between the two teas.
After a month of study, she saw tangible improvements.
Her tenacious spirit carried the team through tough times.
Eggs are one of the most versatile ingredients in the kitchen.

words.meaning: 切實可行的；能獨立存續的
words.example: Solar power is an increasingly viable energy source.
This decision played a pivotal role in the project's success.

words.meaning: 催化劑；促使變化的契機
words.example: The workshop served as a catalyst for new creative ideas.
Keep commit messages clear and concise.
Open communication helps foster trust within a team.

words.meaning: 迫在眉睫的；即將來臨的
words.example: Dark clouds signaled that a heavy storm was imminent.
Curiosity is an intrinsic motivation for lifelong learning.

name: 軟體工程詞彙
description: 讀技術文件、API 設計與系統架構必備的開發英文

words.meaning: 冪等的（執行一次與重複執行多次結果一致）
words.example: HTTP PUT and DELETE requests are designed to be idempotent.

words.meaning: 不可變的（建立後狀態不可修改）
words.example: Swift structs encourage immutable value semantics.

words.meaning: 並行性；同時處理多項任務
words.example: Swift 6 checks data-race safety using structured concurrency.

words.meaning: 延遲時間（從發出請求到收到回應的耗時）
words.example: Caching hot keys in memory drastically reduced tail latency.

words.meaning: 吞吐量（單位時間內處理的工作量）
words.example: Batching writes improved database throughput by 4x.

words.meaning: 棄用；標記為不建議使用
words.example: This legacy API was deprecated in favor of async/await.

words.meaning: 啟發式經驗法則（不保證最佳但實用的解法）
words.example: A* search uses a heuristic function to estimate remaining cost.
Profiling revealed that disk I/O was the main bottleneck.

words.meaning: 遙測資料（系統自動蒐集的指標與日誌）
words.example: Telemetry metrics alerted us before users noticed the outage.

words.meaning: 編排；協調多個服務或流程
words.example: Kubernetes orchestrates containers across a cluster of nodes.

words.meaning: 確定性的（相同輸入必定產生相同輸出）
words.example: Unit tests should be deterministic and never depend on wall-clock luck.

words.meaning: 暫時性的；短暫閃現的（例如瞬斷錯誤）
words.example: Exponential backoff works well for transient network failures.

words.meaning: 有效負載（封包或請求中實際傳遞的資料本體）
words.example: Compressing the JSON payload saved 60% of bandwidth.

words.meaning: 封送／序列化（將記憶體物件轉為傳輸或儲存格式）
words.example: The client marshals the struct into protobuf bytes before sending.

words.meaning: 防抖動（停止連續觸發一小段時間後才執行一次）
words.example: We debounce the search input by 250ms to avoid spamming queries.

words.meaning: 節流／限速（限制單位時間內的最高執行頻率）
words.example: Scroll handlers are throttled to run at most once per frame.

words.meaning: 不變量（程式執行前後恆成立的條件）
words.example: Assertions document class invariants and catch bugs early.

words.meaning: 調和／對帳（比對差異並使兩邊狀態一致）
words.example: SwiftUI reconciles the view tree whenever @Published state changes.

words.meaning: 迴歸錯誤（原本正常的功能改壞了）
words.example: Adding an automated test prevents this regression from coming back.
macOS timers coalesce nearby wakeups to save battery power.

name: 多益商務精選
description: 職場書信、會議、合約與差旅常見高頻單字

words.meaning: 行程表；旅遊或出差路線規劃
words.example: Please review the updated flight itinerary before tomorrow's trip.

words.meaning: 核銷；報帳償還（墊付的費用）
words.example: Keep your receipts so the company can reimburse your travel expenses.

words.meaning: 暫定的；初步未最終拍板的
words.example: We set a tentative launch date for mid-November.
The firm opened a new wholly owned subsidiary in Tokyo.

words.meaning: 採購（企業取得設備或原物料的流程）
words.example: All hardware orders go through the procurement department.
Annual audits ensure full compliance with privacy regulations.
Effective managers know how to delegate tasks clearly.
After a brief discussion, the committee reached a consensus.
Express shipping was requested to expedite the delivery.
Daily XP rewards provide a fun incentive to review vocabulary.
Retailers check their inventory carefully ahead of the holiday season.
Wearing safety badges is mandatory inside the facility.
Both parties met to negotiate the terms of the renewal contract.
The offer includes competitive remuneration and flexible hours.

words.meaning: 明文規定；在契約中載明
words.example: The agreement stipulates a thirty-day notice period.
The laptop comes with a two-year manufacturer warranty.
Cloud services grew into the company's most lucrative division.
Revenue rose 12% in the fourth quarter of the fiscal year.
Several industry experts endorsed the new open standard.
Let's review the first item on today's meeting agenda.
